releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 2.0.0 (PETS & THE PUBLIC SERVER)

THE WHOLE NEW SYSTEM IS HERE!

- JOIN PUBLIC SERVER: a new button on the main menu. Everyone on your island sees you walk, swing your axe and lead your pets, with your name over your head. Press T to chat, hold Tab to see who's online. Your progress stays your own.
- ANNOUNCEMENTS: news from the admin shows up as a banner in game and on the main menu.
- PETS: psst... Sly's Black Market is a shady cart beside the enchanting table on every island. Buy a Burlap Sack, a Smuggler's Crate or a Reaper's Coffer and spin for one of 24 pets in five rarities (2.5% chance of a SHINY).
- Pets follow you and each has a perk: axe damage, more logs, more cash, speed, mutation luck, log reach, or biting the tree you're chopping. Duplicates add stars. Press P to see your pets. A third pet slot opens at Rebirth 8.
- REBIRTH 8: MIDWEST ISLAND. Talk to the Ferryman on Mega Town to sail there.
- NEW TREES on Midwest Island: the Dune Stalker, Terracotta Sentinel, Mesa Stonewood, Dust Storm Snag and Tumbleweed.
